177:   # Make score changes based on the raising of a specific stat.
178:   def get_target_stat_raise_score_one(score, target, stat, increment, desire_mult = 1)
179:     # Figure out how much the stat will actually change by
180:     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
181:     stage_mul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
182:     stage_div = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
183:     if [:ACCURACY, :EVASION].include?(stat)
184:       stage_mul = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
185:       stage_div = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_DIVISORS
186:     end
187:     old_stage = target.stages[stat]
188:     new_stage = old_stage + increment
189:     inc_mult = (stage_mul[new_stage + max_stage].to_f * stage_div[old_stage + max_stage]) / (stage_div[new_stage + max_stage] * stage_mul[old_stage + max_stage])
190:     inc_mult -= 1
191:     inc_mult *= desire_mult
192:     # Stat-based score changes
193:     case stat
194:     when :ATTACK
195:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
196:       # More strongly prefer if the target has no special moves
197:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
198:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
199:       else
200:         has_special_moves = target.check_for_move { |m| m.specialMove?(m.type) }
201:         inc = (has_special_moves) ? 8 : 12
202:         score += inc * inc_mult
203:       end
204:     when :DEFENSE
205:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
206:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
207:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
208:       else
209:         score += 10 * inc_mult
210:       end

211:     when :SPECIAL_ATTACK
212:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
213:       # More strongly prefer if the target has no physical moves
214:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
215:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
216:       else
217:         has_physical_moves = target.check_for_move { |m| m.physicalMove?(m.type) &&
218:                                                          m.function_code != "UseUserDefenseInsteadOfUserAttack" &&
219:                                                          m.function_code != "UseTargetAttackInsteadOfUserAttack" }
220:         inc = (has_physical_moves) ? 8 : 12
221:         score += inc * inc_mult
222:       end
223:     when :SPECIAL_DEFENSE
224:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
225:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
226:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
227:       else
228:         score += 10 * inc_mult
229:       end
230:     when :SPEED
231:       # Prefer if target is slower than a foe
232:       target_speed = target.rough_stat(:SPEED)
233:       each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
234:         b_speed = b.rough_stat(:SPEED)
235:         next if b_speed <= target_speed   # Target already outspeeds the foe b
236:         next if b_speed > target_speed * 2.5   # Much too slow to reasonably catch up
237:         if b_speed < target_speed * (increment + 2) / 2
238:           score += 15 * inc_mult   # Target will become faster than the foe b
239:         else
240:           score += 8 * inc_mult
241:         end
242:         break
243:       end
244:       # Prefer if the target has Electro Ball or Power Trip/Stored Power
245:       moves_that_prefer_high_speed = [
246:         "PowerHigherWithUserFasterThanTarget",
247:         "PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages"
248:       ]
249:       if target.has_move_with_function?(*moves_that_prefer_high_speed)
250:         score += 5 * inc_mult
251:       end
252:       # Don't prefer if any foe has Gyro Ball
253:       each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
254:         next if !b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithTargetFasterThanUser")
255:         score -= 5 * inc_mult
256:       end
257:       # Don't prefer if target has Speed Boost (will be gaining Speed anyway)
258:       if target.has_active_ability?(:SPEEDBOOST)
259:         score -= 15 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
260:       end
261:     when :ACCURACY
262:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
263:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
264:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
265:       else
266:         min_accuracy = 100
267:         target.battler.moves.each do |m|
268:           next if m.accuracy == 0 || m.is_a?(Battle::Move::OHKO)
269:           min_accuracy = m.accuracy if m.accuracy < min_accuracy
270:         end
271:         min_accuracy = min_accuracy * stage_mul[old_stage] / stage_div[old_stage]
272:         if min_accuracy < 90
273:           score += 10 * inc_mult
274:         end
275:       end
276:     when :EVASION
277:       # Prefer if a foe of the target will take damage at the end of the round
278:       each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
279:         eor_damage = b.rough_end_of_round_damage
280:         score += 5 * inc_mult if eor_damage > 0
281:       end
282:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
283:       if old_stage >= 2 && increment == 1
284:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
285:       else
286:         score += 10 * inc_mult
287:       end
288:     end
289:     # Prefer if target has Stored Power
290:     if target.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages")
291:       score += 5 * increment * desire_mult
292:     end
293:     # Don't prefer if any foe has Punishment
294:     each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
295:       next if !b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithTargetPositiveStatStages")
296:       score -= 5 * increment * desire_mult
297:     end
298:     return score
299:   end

430:       end
431:     when :ACCURACY
432:       meaningful = false
433:       target.battler.moves.each do |m|
434:         meaningful = true if m.accuracy > 0 && !m.is_a?(Battle::Move::OHKO)
435:         break if meaningful
436:       end
437:       return false if !meaningful
438:     when :EVASION
439:     end
440:     return true

445:   # Make score changes based on the general concept of lowering stats at all.
446:   def get_target_stat_drop_score_generic(score, target, stat_changes, desire_mult = 1)
447:     total_decrement = stat_changes.sum { |change| change[1] }
448:     # Prefer if move is a status move and it's the user's first/second turn
449:     if @user.turnCount < 2 && @move.statusMove?
450:       score += total_decrement * desire_mult * 5
451:     end
452:     if @trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
453:       # Prefer if user is at high HP, don't prefer if user is at low HP
454:       if target.index != @user.index
455:         score += total_decrement * desire_mult * ((100 * @user.hp / @user.totalhp) - 50) / 8   # +6 to -6 per stage
456:       end
457:       # Prefer if target is at high HP, don't prefer if target is at low HP
458:       score += total_decrement * desire_mult * ((100 * target.hp / target.totalhp) - 50) / 8   # +6 to -6 per stage
459:     end
460:     # Don't prefer if target has an ability that triggers upon stat loss
461:     # (Competitive, Defiant)
462:     if target.opposes?(@user) && Battle::AbilityEffects::OnStatLoss[target.ability]
463:       score -= 10
464:     end
465:     return score
466:   end

468:   # Make score changes based on the lowering of a specific stat.
469:   def get_target_stat_drop_score_one(score, target, stat, decrement, desire_mult = 1)
470:     # Figure out how much the stat will actually change by
471:     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
472:     stage_mul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
473:     stage_div = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
474:     if [:ACCURACY, :EVASION].include?(stat)
475:       stage_mul = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
476:       stage_div = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_DIVISORS
477:     end
478:     old_stage = target.stages[stat]
479:     new_stage = old_stage - decrement
480:     dec_mult = (stage_mul[old_stage + max_stage].to_f * stage_div[new_stage + max_stage]) / (stage_div[old_stage + max_stage] * stage_mul[new_stage + max_stage])
481:     dec_mult -= 1
482:     dec_mult *= desire_mult
483:     # Stat-based score changes
484:     case stat
485:     when :ATTACK
486:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
487:       # More strongly prefer if the target has no special moves
488:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
489:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
490:       else
491:         has_special_moves = target.check_for_move { |m| m.specialMove?(m.type) }
492:         dec = (has_special_moves) ? 8 : 12
493:         score += dec * dec_mult
494:       end
495:     when :DEFENSE
496:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
497:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
498:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
499:       else
500:         score += 10 * dec_mult
501:       end
502:     when :SPECIAL_ATTACK
503:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
504:       # More strongly prefer if the target has no physical moves
505:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
506:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
507:       else
508:         has_physical_moves = target.check_for_move { |m| m.physicalMove?(m.type) &&
509:                                                          m.function_code != "UseUserDefenseInsteadOfUserAttack" &&
510:                                                          m.function_code != "UseTargetAttackInsteadOfUserAttack" }
511:         dec = (has_physical_moves) ? 8 : 12
512:         score += dec * dec_mult
513:       end
514:     when :SPECIAL_DEFENSE
515:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
516:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
517:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
518:       else
519:         score += 10 * dec_mult
520:       end
521:     when :SPEED
522:       # Prefer if target is faster than an ally
523:       target_speed = target.rough_stat(:SPEED)
524:       each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
525:         b_speed = b.rough_stat(:SPEED)
526:         next if target_speed < b_speed   # Target is already slower than foe b
527:         next if target_speed > b_speed * 2.5   # Much too fast to reasonably be overtaken
528:         if target_speed < b_speed * 2 / (decrement + 2)
529:           score += 15 * dec_mult   # Target will become slower than foe b
530:         else
531:           score += 8 * dec_mult
532:         end
533:         break
534:       end
535:       # Prefer if any ally has Electro Ball
536:       each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
537:         next if !b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserFasterThanTarget")
538:         score += 5 * dec_mult
539:       end
540:       # Don't prefer if target has Speed Boost (will be gaining Speed anyway)
541:       if target.has_active_ability?(:SPEEDBOOST)
542:         score -= 15 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
543:       end
544:     when :ACCURACY
545:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
546:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
547:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
548:       else
549:         score += 10 * dec_mult
550:       end
551:     when :EVASION
552:       # Modify score depending on current stat stage
553:       if old_stage <= -2 && decrement == 1
554:         score -= 10 * ((target.opposes?(@user)) ? 1 : desire_mult)
555:       else
556:         score += 10 * dec_mult
557:       end
558:     end
559:     # Prefer if target has Stored Power
560:     if target.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages")
561:       score += 5 * decrement * desire_mult
562:     end
563:     # Don't prefer if any foe has Punishment
564:     each_foe_battler(target.side) do |b, i|
565:       next if !b.has_move_with_function?("PowerHigherWithTargetPositiveStatStages")
566:       score -= 5 * decrement * desire_mult
567:     end
568:     return score
569:   end

695:   def get_score_for_terrain(terrain, move_user, starting = false)
696:     ret = 0
697:     ret += 4 if starting && terrain != :None && move_user.has_active_item?(:TERRAINEXTENDER)
698:     # Inherent effects of terrain
699:     each_battler do |b, i|
700:       next if !b.battler.affectedByTerrain?
701:       case terrain
702:       when :Electric
703:         # Immunity to sleep
704:         if b.status == :NONE
705:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -8 : 8
706:         end
707:         if b.effects[PBEffects::Yawn] > 0
708:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -10 : 10
709:         end
710:         # Check for Electric moves
711:         if b.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:ELECTRIC)
712:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -10 : 10
713:         end
714:       when :Grassy
715:         # End of round healing
716:         ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -8 : 8
717:         # Check for Grass moves
718:         if b.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:GRASS)
719:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -10 : 10
720:         end
721:       when :Misty
722:         # Immunity to status problems/confusion
723:         if b.status == :NONE || b.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] == 0
724:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -8 : 8
725:         end
726:         # Check for Dragon moves
727:         if b.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:DRAGON)
728:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? 10 : -10
729:         end
730:       when :Psychic
731:         # Check for priority moves
732:         if b.check_for_move { |m| m.priority > 0 && m.pbTarget(b.battler)&.can_target_one_foe? }
733:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? 10 : -10
734:         end
735:         # Check for Psychic moves
736:         if b.has_damaging_move_of_type?(:PSYCHIC)
737:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -10 : 10
738:         end
739:       end
740:     end
741:     # Held items relating to terrain
742:     seed = {
743:       :Electric => :ELECTRICSEED,
744:       :Grassy   => :GRASSYSEED,
745:       :Misty    => :MISTYSEED,
746:       :Psychic  => :PSYCHICSEED
747:     }[terrain]
748:     each_battler do |b, i|
749:       if seed && b.has_active_item?(seed)
750:         ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -8 : 8
751:       end
752:     end
753:     # Check for abilities/moves affected by the terrain
754:     if @trainer.medium_skill?
755:       abils = {
756:         :Electric => :SURGESURFER,
757:         :Grassy   => :GRASSPELT
758:       }[terrain]
759:       good_moves = {
760:         :Electric => ["DoublePowerInElectricTerrain"],
761:         :Grassy   => ["HealTargetDependingOnGrassyTerrain",
762:                       "HigherPriorityInGrassyTerrain"],
763:         :Misty    => ["UserFaintsPowersUpInMistyTerrainExplosive"],
764:         :Psychic  => ["HitsAllFoesAndPowersUpInPsychicTerrain"]
765:       }[terrain]
766:       bad_moves = {
767:         :Grassy => ["DoublePowerIfTargetUnderground",
768:                     "LowerTargetSpeed1WeakerInGrassyTerrain",
769:                     "RandomPowerDoublePowerIfTargetUnderground"]
770:       }[terrain]
771:       each_battler do |b, i|
772:         next if !b.battler.affectedByTerrain?
773:         # Abilities
774:         if b.has_active_ability?(:MIMICRY)
775:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -5 : 5
776:         end
777:         if abils && b.has_active_ability?(abils)
778:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -8 : 8
779:         end
780:         # Moves
781:         if b.has_move_with_function?("EffectDependsOnEnvironment",
782:                                      "SetUserTypesBasedOnEnvironment",
783:                                      "TypeAndPowerDependOnTerrain",
784:                                      "UseMoveDependingOnEnvironment")
785:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -5 : 5
786:         end
787:         if good_moves && b.has_move_with_function?(*good_moves)
788:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? -5 : 5
789:         end
790:         if bad_moves && b.has_move_with_function?(*bad_moves)
791:           ret += (b.opposes?(move_user)) ? 5 : -5
792:         end
793:       end
794:     end
795:     return ret
796:   end
797: end

152:     next score if !ai.trainer.medium_skill?
153:     next score if !user.has_active_item?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF]) &&
154:                   !user.has_active_ability?(:GORILLATACTICS)
155:     old_score = score
156:     # Really don't prefer status moves (except Trick)
157:     if move.statusMove? && move.function_code != "UserTargetSwapItems"
158:       score -= 25
159:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to be Choiced into a status move")
160:       next score
161:     end
162:     # Don't prefer moves which are 0x against at least one type
163:     move_type = move.rough_type
164:     GameData::Type.each do |type_data|
165:       score -= 8 if type_data.immunities.include?(move_type)
166:     end
167:     # Don't prefer moves with lower accuracy
168:     if move.accuracy > 0
169:       score -= (0.4 * (100 - move.accuracy)).to_i   # -0 (100%) to -39 (1%)
170:     end
171:     # Don't prefer moves with low PP
172:     score -= 10 if move.move.pp <= 5
173:     PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "move is less suitable to be Choiced into")
174:     next score
175:   }
176: )

178: #===============================================================================
179: # Prefer damaging moves if the foe is down to their last Pokémon (opportunistic).
180: # Prefer damaging moves if the AI is down to its last Pokémon but the foe has
181: # more (desperate).
182: #===============================================================================
183: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveScore.add(:damaging_move_and_either_side_no_reserves,
184:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
185:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && move.damagingMove?
186:       reserves = battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide)
187:       foes     = battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOpposingSide)
188:       # Don't mess with scores just because a move is damaging; need to play well
189:       next score if ai.trainer.high_skill? && foes > reserves   # AI is outnumbered
190:       # Prefer damaging moves depending on remaining Pokémon
191:       old_score = score
192:       if foes == 0          # Foe is down to their last Pokémon
193:         score += 10         # => Go for the kill
194:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "prefer damaging moves (no foe party Pokémon left)")
195:       elsif reserves == 0   # AI is down to its last Pokémon, foe has reserves
196:         score += 5          # => Go out with a bang
197:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "prefer damaging moves (no ally party Pokémon left)")
198:       end
199:     end
200:     next score

201:   }
202: )

208: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:target_can_powder_fire_moves,
209:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
210:     if ai.trainer.high_skill? && move.rough_type == :FIRE &&
211:        target.has_move_with_function?("TargetNextFireMoveDamagesTarget") &&
212:        target.faster_than?(user)
213:       old_score = score
214:       score -= 5   # Only 5 because we're not sure target will use Powder
215:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "target knows Powder and could negate Fire moves")
216:     end
217:     next score
218:   }

222: # Don't prefer moves if target knows a move that can make them Electric-type,
223: # and if target is unaffected by Electric moves.

225: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:target_can_make_moves_Electric_and_be_immune,
226:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
227:     next score if !ai.trainer.high_skill?
228:     next score if !target.has_move_with_function?("TargetMovesBecomeElectric") &&
229:                   !(move.rough_type == :NORMAL && target.has_move_with_function?("NormalMovesBecomeElectric"))

231:                   !Effectiveness.ineffective?(target.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:ELECTRIC, user))
232:     priority = move.rough_priority(user)
233:     if priority > 0 || (priority == 0 && target.faster_than?(user))   # Target goes first
234:       old_score = score
235:       score -= 5   # Only 5 because we're not sure target will use Electrify/Ion Deluge
236:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "target knows Electrify/Ion Deluge and is immune to Electric moves")
237:     end

242: #===============================================================================
243: # Don't prefer attacking the target if they'd be semi-invulnerable.
244: #===============================================================================
245: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:target_semi_invulnerable,
246:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
247:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && move.rough_accuracy > 0 &&
248:        (target.battler.semiInvulnerable? || target.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0)
249:       next score if user.has_active_ability?(:NOGUARD) || target.has_active_ability?(:NOGUARD)
250:       priority = move.rough_priority(user)
251:       if priority > 0 || (priority == 0 && user.faster_than?(target))   # User goes first
252:         miss = true
253:         if ai.trainer.high_skill?
254:           # Knows what can get past semi-invulnerability
255:           if target.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0 ||
256:              target.battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSky",
257:                                              "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyParalyzeTarget",
258:                                              "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct")
259:             miss = false if move.move.hitsFlyingTargets?
260:           elsif target.battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableUnderground")
261:             miss = false if move.move.hitsDiggingTargets?
262:           elsif target.battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableUnderwater")
263:             miss = false if move.move.hitsDivingTargets?
264:           end
265:         end
266:         if miss
267:           old_score = score
268:           score = Battle::AI::MOVE_USELESS_SCORE
269:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "target is semi-invulnerable")
270:         end
271:       end
272:     end
273:     next score
274:   }

278: # Account for accuracy of move.
279: #===============================================================================
280: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:predicted_accuracy,
281:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
282:     acc = move.rough_accuracy.to_i
283:     if acc < 90
284:       old_score = score
285:       score -= (0.25 * (100 - acc)).to_i   # -2 (89%) to -24 (1%)
286:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "accuracy (predicted #{acc}%)")
287:     end
288:     next score
289:   }

292: #===============================================================================
293: # Adjust score based on how much damage it can deal.
294: # Prefer the move even more if it's predicted to do enough damage to KO the
295: # target.
296: #===============================================================================
297: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:predicted_damage,
298:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
299:     if move.damagingMove?
300:       dmg = move.rough_damage
301:       old_score = score
302:       if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
303:         target_hp = target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute]
304:         score += ([15.0 * dmg / target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute], 20].min).to_i
305:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "damaging move (predicted damage #{dmg} = #{100 * dmg / target.hp}% of target's Substitute)")
306:       else
307:         score += ([25.0 * dmg / target.hp, 30].min).to_i
308:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "damaging move (predicted damage #{dmg} = #{100 * dmg / target.hp}% of target's HP)")
309:         if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") && dmg > target.hp * 1.1   # Predicted to KO the target
310:           old_score = score
311:           score += 10
312:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "predicted to KO the target")
313:           if move.move.multiHitMove? && target.hp == target.totalhp &&
314:              (target.has_active_ability?(:STURDY) || target.has_active_item?(:FOCUSSASH))
315:             old_score = score
316:             score += 8
317:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "predicted to overcome the target's Sturdy/Focus Sash")
318:           end
319:         end
320:       end
321:     end
322:     next score
323:   }
324: )

327: # Prefer flinching external effects (note that move effects which cause
328: # flinching are dealt with in the function code part of score calculation).

331:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
332:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && move.damagingMove? && !move.move.flinchingMove? &&
333:        user.faster_than?(target) && target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0

335:          user.has_active_ability?(:STENCH)
336:         if battle.moldBreaker || !target.has_active_ability?([:INNERFOCUS, :SHIELDDUST])
337:           old_score = score
338:           score += 8
339:           score += 5 if move.move.multiHitMove?
340:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "added chance to cause flinching")
341:         end
342:       end
343:     end
344:     next score
345:   }

349: # If target is frozen, don't prefer moves that could thaw them.

352:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|

354:       if move.rough_type == :FIRE || (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 && move.move.thawsUser?)
355:         old_score = score
356:         score -= 20

359:     end

364: #===============================================================================
365: # Don't prefer a damaging move if it will trigger the target's ability or held
366: # item when used, e.g. Effect Spore/Rough Skin, Pickpocket, Rocky Helmet, Red
367: # Card.
368: # NOTE: These abilities/items may not be triggerable after all (e.g. they
369: #       require the move to make contact but it doesn't), or may have a negative
370: #       effect for the target (e.g. Air Balloon popping), but it's too much
371: #       effort to go into detail deciding all this.
372: #===============================================================================
373: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:trigger_target_ability_or_item_upon_hit,
374:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
375:     if ai.trainer.high_skill? && move.damagingMove? && target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0
376:       if target.ability_active?
377:         if Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit[target.ability] ||
378:            (Battle::AbilityEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget[target.ability] &&
379:            (!user.has_active_ability?(:SHEERFORCE) || move.move.addlEffect == 0))
380:           old_score = score
381:           score += 8
382:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's ability")
383:         end
384:       end
385:       if target.battler.isSpecies?(:CRAMORANT) && target.ability == :GULPMISSILE &&

386:          target.battler.form > 0 && !target.effects[PBEffects::Transform]
387:         old_score = score
388:         score += 8
389:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's ability")
390:       end
391:       if target.item_active?
392:         if Battle::ItemEffects::OnBeingHit[target.item] ||
393:            (Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget[target.item] &&
394:            (!user.has_active_ability?(:SHEERFORCE) || move.move.addlEffect == 0))
395:           old_score = score
396:           score += 8
397:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's item")
398:         end
399:       end
400:     end
401:     next score
402:   }
403: )

405: #===============================================================================
406: # Prefer a damaging move if it will trigger the user's ability when used, e.g.
407: # Poison Touch, Magician.
408: #===============================================================================
409: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:trigger_user_ability_upon_hit,
410:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
411:     if ai.trainer.high_skill? && user.ability_active? && move.damagingMove? &&
412:        target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0
413:       # NOTE: The only ability with an OnDealingHit effect also requires the
414:       #       move to make contact. The only abilities with an OnEndOfUsingMove
415:       #       effect revolve around damaging moves.
416:       if (Battle::AbilityEffects::OnDealingHit[user.ability] && move.move.contactMove?) ||
417:          Battle::AbilityEffects::OnEndOfUsingMove[user.ability]
418:         old_score = score
419:         score += 8
420:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the user's ability")
421:       end
422:     end
423:     next score
424:   }

427: #===============================================================================
428: # Don't prefer damaging moves that will knock out the target if they are using
429: # Destiny Bond or Grudge.
430: #===============================================================================
431: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:knocking_out_a_destiny_bonder_or_grudger,
432:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
433:     if (ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") || ai.trainer.high_skill?) && move.damagingMove? &&
434:        (target.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond] || target.effects[PBEffects::Grudge])
435:       priority = move.rough_priority(user)
436:       if priority > 0 || (priority == 0 && user.faster_than?(target))   # User goes first
437:         if move.rough_damage > target.hp * 1.1   # Predicted to KO the target
438:           old_score = score
439:           if target.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond]
440:             score -= 20
441:             score -= 10 if battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide) == 0
442:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to KO the Destiny Bonding target")
443:           elsif target.effects[PBEffects::Grudge]
444:             score -= 15
445:             score -= 7 if battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide) == 0
446:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to KO the Grudge-using target")
447:           end
448:         end
449:       end
450:     end
451:     next score
452:   }

455: #===============================================================================
456: # Don't prefer damaging moves if the target is using Rage, unless the move will
457: # deal enough damage to KO the target within two rounds.
458: #===============================================================================
459: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:damaging_a_raging_target,
460:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
461:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && target.effects[PBEffects::Rage] && move.damagingMove?
462:       # Worth damaging the target if it can be knocked out within two rounds
463:       if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
464:         next score if (move.rough_damage + target.rough_end_of_round_damage) * 2 > target.hp * 1.1
465:       end
466:       old_score = score
467:       score -= 10
468:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to damage a Raging target")
469:     end
470:     next score
471:   }
472: )

474: #===============================================================================
475: # Don't prefer damaging moves if the target is Biding, unless the move will deal
476: # enough damage to KO the target before it retaliates (assuming the move is used
477: # repeatedly until the target retaliates). Doesn't do a score change if the user
478: # will be immune to Bide's damage.
479: #===============================================================================
480: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:damaging_a_biding_target,
481:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
482:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && target.effects[PBEffects::Bide] > 0 && move.damagingMove?
483:       eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:NORMAL, target)   # Bide is Normal type
484:       if !Effectiveness.ineffective?(eff)
485:         # Worth damaging the target if it can be knocked out before Bide ends
486:         if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
487:           dmg = move.rough_damage
488:           eor_dmg = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
489:           hits_possible = target.effects[PBEffects::Bide] - 1
490:           eor_dmg *= hits_possible
491:           hits_possible += 1 if user.faster_than?(target)
492:           next score if (dmg * hits_possible) + eor_dmg > target.hp * 1.1
493:         end
494:         old_score = score
495:         score -= 20
496:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to damage the Biding target")
497:       end
498:     end
499:     next score
500:   }
501: )

503: #===============================================================================
504: # Don't prefer a dancing move if the target has the Dancer ability.
505: #===============================================================================
506: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveScore.add(:dance_move_against_dancer,
507:   proc { |score, move, user, ai, battle|
508:     if move.move.danceMove?
509:       old_score = score
510:       ai.each_foe_battler(user.side) do |b, i|
511:         score -= 10 if b.has_active_ability?(:DANCER)
512:       end
513:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to use a dance move because a foe has Dancer")
514:     end
515:     next score
516:   }
517: )

9:   def each_battler
10:     @battlers.each_with_index do |battler, i|
11:       next if !battler || battler.fainted?
12:       yield battler, i
13:     end

16:   def each_foe_battler(side)
17:     @battlers.each_with_index do |battler, i|
18:       next if !battler || battler.fainted?
19:       yield battler, i if i.even? != side.even?
20:     end
21:   end

23:   def each_same_side_battler(side)
24:     @battlers.each_with_index do |battler, i|
25:       next if !battler || battler.fainted?
26:       yield battler, i if i.even? == side.even?
27:     end
28:   end

30:   def each_ally(index)
31:     @battlers.each_with_index do |battler, i|
32:       next if !battler || battler.fainted?
33:       yield battler, i if i != index && i.even? == index.even?
34:     end

39:   # Assumes that pkmn's ability is not negated by a global effect (e.g.
40:   # Neutralizing Gas).
41:   # pkmn is either a Battle::AI::AIBattler or a Pokemon.
42:   # move is a Battle::Move or a Pokemon::Move.
43:   def pokemon_can_absorb_move?(pkmn, move, move_type)
44:     return false if pkmn.is_a?(Battle::AI::AIBattler) && !pkmn.ability_active?
45:     # Check pkmn's ability
46:     # Anything with a Battle::AbilityEffects::MoveImmunity handler
47:     case pkmn.ability_id
48:     when :BULLETPROOF
49:       move_data = GameData::Move.get(move.id)
50:       return move_data.has_flag?("Bomb")
51:     when :FLASHFIRE
52:       return move_type == :FIRE
53:     when :LIGHTNINGROD, :MOTORDRIVE, :VOLTABSORB
54:       return move_type == :ELECTRIC
55:     when :SAPSIPPER
56:       return move_type == :GRASS
57:     when :SOUNDPROOF
58:       move_data = GameData::Move.get(move.id)
59:       return move_data.has_flag?("Sound")
60:     when :STORMDRAIN, :WATERABSORB, :DRYSKIN
61:       return move_type == :WATER
62:     when :TELEPATHY
63:       # NOTE: The move is being used by a foe of pkmn.
64:       return false
65:     when :WONDERGUARD
66:       types = pkmn.types
67:       types = pkmn.pbTypes(true) if pkmn.is_a?(Battle::AI::AIBattler)
68:       return !Effectiveness.super_effective_type?(move_type, *types)
69:     end
70:     return false
71:   end

73:   # Used by Toxic Spikes.
74:   def pokemon_can_be_poisoned?(pkmn)
75:     # Check pkmn's immunity to being poisoned
76:     return false if @battle.field.terrain == :Misty
77:     return false if pkmn.hasType?(:POISON)
78:     return false if pkmn.hasType?(:STEEL)
79:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:IMMUNITY)
80:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:PASTELVEIL)
81:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:FLOWERVEIL) && pkmn.hasType?(:GRASS)
82:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:LEAFGUARD) && [:Sun, :HarshSun].include?(@battle.pbWeather)
83:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:COMATOSE) && pkmn.isSpecies?(:KOMALA)
84:     return false if pkmn.hasAbility?(:SHIELDSDOWN) && pkmn.isSpecies?(:MINIOR) && pkmn.form < 7
85:     return true
86:   end

88:   def pokemon_airborne?(pkmn)
89:     return false if pkmn.hasItem?(:IRONBALL)
90:     return false if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0
91:     return true if pkmn.hasType?(:FLYING)
92:     return true if pkmn.hasAbility?(:LEVITATE)
93:     return true if pkmn.hasItem?(:AIRBALLOON)
94:     return false

16:     old_party_index = @party_index
17:     @battler = @ai.battle.battlers[@index]
18:     @party_index = battler.pokemonIndex

54:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
55: 
56:   # Returns how much damage this battler will take at the end of this round.
57:   def rough_end_of_round_damage
58:     ret = 0
59:     # Weather
60:     weather = battler.effectiveWeather
61:     if @ai.battle.field.weatherDuration == 1
62:       weather = @ai.battle.field.defaultWeather
63:       weather = :None if @ai.battle.allBattlers.any? { |b| b.hasActiveAbility?([:CLOUDNINE, :AIRLOCK]) }
64:       weather = :None if [:Sun, :Rain, :HarshSun, :HeavyRain].include?(weather) && has_active_item?(:UTILITYUMBRELLA)
65:     end
66:     case weather
67:     when :Sandstorm
68:       ret += [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if battler.takesSandstormDamage?
69:     when :Hail
70:       ret += [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if battler.takesHailDamage?
71:     when :ShadowSky
72:       ret += [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if battler.takesShadowSkyDamage?
73:     end
74:     case ability_id
75:     when :DRYSKIN
76:       ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if [:Sun, :HarshSun].include?(weather) && battler.takesIndirectDamage?
77:       ret -= [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if [:Rain, :HeavyRain].include?(weather) && battler.canHeal?
78:     when :ICEBODY
79:       ret -= [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if weather == :Hail && battler.canHeal?
80:     when :RAINDISH
81:       ret -= [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if [:Rain, :HeavyRain].include?(weather) && battler.canHeal?
82:     when :SOLARPOWER
83:       ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if [:Sun, :HarshSun].include?(weather) && battler.takesIndirectDamage?
84:     end
85:     # Future Sight/Doom Desire
86:     # NOTE: Not worth estimating the damage from this.
87:     # Wish
88:     if @ai.battle.positions[@index].effects[PBEffects::Wish] == 1 && battler.canHeal?
89:       ret -= @ai.battle.positions[@index].effects[PBEffects::WishAmount]
90:     end
91:     # Sea of Fire
92:     if @ai.battle.sides[@side].effects[PBEffects::SeaOfFire] > 1 &&
93:        battler.takesIndirectDamage? && !has_type?(:FIRE)
94:       ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max
95:     end
96:     # Grassy Terrain (healing)
97:     if @ai.battle.field.terrain == :Grassy && battler.affectedByTerrain? && battler.canHeal?
98:       ret -= [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max
99:     end
100:     # Leftovers/Black Sludge
101:     if has_active_item?(:BLACKSLUDGE)
102:       if has_type?(:POISON)
103:         ret -= [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if battler.canHeal?
104:       else
105:         ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
106:       end
107:     elsif has_active_item?(:LEFTOVERS)
108:       ret -= [self.totalhp / 16, 1].max if battler.canHeal?
109:     end
110:     # Aqua Ring
111:     if self.effects[PBEffects::AquaRing] && battler.canHeal?
112:       amt = self.totalhp / 16
113:       amt = (amt * 1.3).floor if has_active_item?(:BIGROOT)
114:       ret -= [amt, 1].max
115:     end
116:     # Ingrain
117:     if self.effects[PBEffects::Ingrain] && battler.canHeal?
118:       amt = self.totalhp / 16
119:       amt = (amt * 1.3).floor if has_active_item?(:BIGROOT)
120:       ret -= [amt, 1].max
121:     end
122:     # Leech Seed
123:     if self.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] >= 0
124:       if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
125:         ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
126:       end
127:     else
128:       @ai.each_battler do |b, i|
129:         next if i == @index || b.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] != @index
130:         amt = [[b.totalhp / 8, b.hp].min, 1].max
131:         amt = (amt * 1.3).floor if has_active_item?(:BIGROOT)
132:         ret -= [amt, 1].max
133:       end
134:     end
135:     # Hyper Mode (Shadow Pokémon)
136:     if battler.inHyperMode?
137:       ret += [self.totalhp / 24, 1].max
138:     end
139:     # Poison/burn/Nightmare
140:     if self.status == :POISON
141:       if has_active_ability?(:POISONHEAL)
142:         ret -= [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max if battler.canHeal?
143:       elsif battler.takesIndirectDamage?
144:         mult = 2
145:         mult = [self.effects[PBEffects::Toxic] + 1, 16].min if self.statusCount > 0   # Toxic
146:         ret += [mult * self.totalhp / 16, 1].max
147:       end
148:     elsif self.status == :BURN
149:       if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
150:         amt = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 7) ? self.totalhp / 16 : self.totalhp / 8
151:         amt = (amt / 2.0).round if has_active_ability?(:HEATPROOF)
152:         ret += [amt, 1].max
153:       end
154:     elsif battler.asleep? && self.statusCount > 1 && self.effects[PBEffects::Nightmare]
155:       ret += [self.totalhp / 4, 1].max if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
156:     end
157:     # Curse
158:     if self.effects[PBEffects::Curse]
159:       ret += [self.totalhp / 4, 1].max if battler.takesIndirectDamage?
160:     end
161:     # Trapping damage
162:     if self.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] > 1 && battler.takesIndirectDamage?
163:       amt = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? self.totalhp / 8 : self.totalhp / 16
164:       if @ai.battlers[self.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser]].has_active_item?(:BINDINGBAND)
165:         amt = (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6) ? self.totalhp / 6 : self.totalhp / 8
166:       end
167:       ret += [amt, 1].max
168:     end
169:     # Perish Song
170:     return 999_999 if self.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 1
171:     # Bad Dreams
172:     if battler.asleep? && self.statusCount > 1 && battler.takesIndirectDamage?
173:       @ai.each_battler do |b, i|
174:         next if i == @index || !b.battler.near?(battler) || !b.has_active_ability?(:BADDREAMS)
175:         ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max
176:       end
177:     end
178:     # Sticky Barb
179:     if has_active_item?(:STICKYBARB) && battler.takesIndirectDamage?
180:       ret += [self.totalhp / 8, 1].max
181:     end
182:     return ret
183:   end

187:   def base_stat(stat)
188:     ret = 0
189:     case stat
190:     when :ATTACK          then ret = battler.attack
191:     when :DEFENSE         then ret = battler.defense

400:   # Returns a value indicating how beneficial the given ability will be to this
401:   # battler if it has it.
402:   # Return values are typically between -10 and +10. 0 is indifferent, positive
403:   # values mean this battler benefits, negative values mean this battler suffers.
404:   # NOTE: This method assumes the ability isn't being negated. The calculations
405:   #       that call this method separately check for it being negated, because

406:   #       they need to do something special in that case.
407:   def wants_ability?(ability = :NONE)
408:     ability = ability.id if !ability.is_a?(Symbol) && ability.respond_to?("id")
409:     # Get the base ability rating
410:     ret = 0
411:     Battle::AI::BASE_ABILITY_RATINGS.each_pair do |val, abilities|
412:       next if !abilities.include?(ability)
413:       ret = val
414:       break
415:     end
416:     # Modify the rating based on ability-specific contexts
417:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
418:       ret = Battle::AI::Handlers.modify_ability_ranking(ability, ret, self, @ai)
419:     end
420:     return ret

425:   # Returns a value indicating how beneficial the given item will be to this
426:   # battler if it is holding it.
427:   # Return values are typically between -10 and +10. 0 is indifferent, positive
428:   # values mean this battler benefits, negative values mean this battler suffers.
429:   # NOTE: This method assumes the item isn't being negated. The calculations
430:   #       that call this method separately check for it being negated, because
431:   #       they need to do something special in that case.
432:   def wants_item?(item)
433:     item = :NONE if !item
434:     item = item.id if !item.is_a?(Symbol) && item.respond_to?("id")
435:     # Get the base item rating
436:     ret = 0
437:     Battle::AI::BASE_ITEM_RATINGS.each_pair do |val, items|
438:       next if !items.include?(item)
439:       ret = val
440:       break
441:     end
442:     # Modify the rating based on item-specific contexts
443:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
444:       ret = Battle::AI::Handlers.modify_item_ranking(item, ret, self, @ai)
445:     end
446:     # Prefer if this battler knows Fling and it will do a lot of damage/have an
447:     # additional (negative) effect when flung
448:     if item != :NONE && has_move_with_function?("ThrowUserItemAtTarget")
449:       GameData::Item.get(item).flags.each do |flag|
450:         next if !flag[/^Fling_(\d+)$/i]
451:         amt = $~[1].to_i
452:         ret += 1 if amt >= 80
453:         ret += 1 if amt >= 100
454:         break
455:       end
456:       if [:FLAMEORB, :KINGSROCK, :LIGHTBALL, :POISONBARB, :RAZORFANG, :TOXICORB].include?(item)
457:         ret += 1
458:       end
459:     end
460:     # Don't prefer if this battler knows Acrobatics
461:     if has_move_with_function?("DoublePowerIfUserHasNoItem")
462:       ret += (item == :NONE) ? 1 : -1
463:     end
464:     return ret
465:   end

469:   # Items can be consumed by Stuff Cheeks, Teatime, Bug Bite/Pluck and Fling.
470:   def get_score_change_for_consuming_item(item, try_preserving_item = false)
471:     ret = 0
472:     case item
473:     when :ORANBERRY, :BERRYJUICE, :ENIGMABERRY, :SITRUSBERRY
474:       # Healing
475:       ret += (hp > totalhp * 0.75) ? -6 : 6
476:       ret = ret * 3 / 2 if GameData::Item.get(item).is_berry? && has_active_ability?(:RIPEN)
477:     when :AGUAVBERRY, :FIGYBERRY, :IAPAPABERRY, :MAGOBERRY, :WIKIBERRY
478:       # Healing with confusion
479:       fraction_to_heal = 8   # Gens 6 and lower
480:       if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION == 7
481:         fraction_to_heal = 2
482:       elsif Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8
483:         fraction_to_heal = 3
484:       end
485:       ret += (hp > totalhp * (1 - (1.0 / fraction_to_heal))) ? -6 : 6
486:       ret = ret * 3 / 2 if GameData::Item.get(item).is_berry? && has_active_ability?(:RIPEN)
487:       if @ai.trainer.high_skill?
488:         flavor_stat = {
489:           :AGUAVBERRY  => :SPECIAL_DEFENSE,
490:           :FIGYBERRY   => :ATTACK,
491:           :IAPAPABERRY => :DEFENSE,
492:           :MAGOBERRY   => :SPEED,
493:           :WIKIBERRY   => :SPECIAL_ATTACK
494:         }[item]
495:         if @battler.nature.stat_changes.any? { |val| val[0] == flavor_stat && val[1] < 0 }
496:           ret -= 3 if @battler.pbCanConfuseSelf?(false)
497:         end
498:       end
499:     when :ASPEARBERRY, :CHERIBERRY, :CHESTOBERRY, :PECHABERRY, :RAWSTBERRY
500:       # Status cure
501:       cured_status = {
502:         :ASPEAR      => :FROZEN,
503:         :CHERIBERRY  => :PARALYSIS,
504:         :CHESTOBERRY => :SLEEP,
505:         :PECHABERRY  => :POISON,
506:         :RAWSTBERRY  => :BURN
507:       }[item]
508:       ret += (cured_status && status == cured_status) ? 6 : -6
509:     when :PERSIMBERRY
510:       # Confusion cure
511:       ret += (self.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 1) ? 6 : -6
512:     when :LUMBERRY
513:       # Any status/confusion cure
514:       ret += (status != :NONE || self.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 1) ? 6 : -6
515:     when :MENTALHERB
516:       # Cure mental effects
517:       if self.effects[PBEffects::Attract] >= 0 ||
518:          self.effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 1 ||
519:          self.effects[PBEffects::Encore] > 1 ||
520:          self.effects[PBEffects::Torment] ||
521:          self.effects[PBEffects::Disable] > 1 ||
522:          self.effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 1
523:         ret += 6
524:       else
525:         ret -= 6
526:       end
527:     when :APICOTBERRY, :GANLONBERRY, :LIECHIBERRY, :PETAYABERRY, :SALACBERRY,
528:          :KEEBERRY, :MARANGABERRY
529:       # Stat raise
530:       stat = {
531:         :APICOTBERRY  => :SPECIAL_DEFENSE,
532:         :GANLONBERRY  => :DEFENSE,
533:         :LIECHIBERRY  => :ATTACK,
534:         :PETAYABERRY  => :SPECIAL_ATTACK,
535:         :SALACBERRY   => :SPEED,
536:         :KEEBERRY     => :DEFENSE,
537:         :MARANGABERRY => :SPECIAL_DEFENSE
538:       }[item]
539:       ret += (stat && @ai.stat_raise_worthwhile?(self, stat)) ? 8 : -8
540:       ret = ret * 3 / 2 if GameData::Item.get(item).is_berry? && has_active_ability?(:RIPEN)
541:     when :STARFBERRY
542:       # Random stat raise
543:       ret += 8
544:       ret = ret * 3 / 2 if GameData::Item.get(item).is_berry? && has_active_ability?(:RIPEN)
545:     when :WHITEHERB
546:       # Resets lowered stats
547:       ret += (battler.hasLoweredStatStages?) ? 8 : -8
548:     when :MICLEBERRY
549:       # Raises accuracy of next move
550:       ret += (@ai.stat_raise_worthwhile?(self, :ACCURACY, true)) ? 6 : -6
551:     when :LANSATBERRY
552:       # Focus energy
553:       ret += (self.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy] < 2) ? 6 : -6
554:     when :LEPPABERRY
555:       # Restore PP
556:       ret += 6
557:       ret = ret * 3 / 2 if GameData::Item.get(item).is_berry? && has_active_ability?(:RIPEN)
558:     end
559:     ret = 0 if ret < 0 && !try_preserving_item
560:     return ret
561:   end

567:   def effectiveness_of_type_against_single_battler_type(type, defend_type, user = nil)
568:     ret = Effectiveness.calculate(type, defend_type)
569:     if Effectiveness.ineffective_type?(type, defend_type)
570:       # Ring Target
571:       if has_active_item?(:RINGTARGET)
572:         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
573:       end
574:       # Foresight
575:       if (user&.has_active_ability?(:SCRAPPY) || self.effects[PBEffects::Foresight]) &&
576:          defend_type == :GHOST
577:         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
578:       end
579:       # Miracle Eye
580:       if self.effects[PBEffects::MiracleEye] && defend_type == :DARK
581:         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
582:       end
583:     elsif Effectiveness.super_effective_type?(type, defend_type)
584:       # Delta Stream's weather
585:       if battler.effectiveWeather == :StrongWinds && defend_type == :FLYING
586:         ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
587:       end
588:     end
589:     # Grounded Flying-type Pokémon become susceptible to Ground moves
590:     if !battler.airborne? && defend_type == :FLYING && type == :GROUND
591:       ret = Effectiveness::NORMAL_EFFECTIVE_MULTIPLIER
592:     end
593:     return ret
594:   end
595: end

4: class Battle::AI::AIMove

12:     @move = move
13:     @move.calcType = rough_type
14:     @ai.battle.moldBreaker ||= ["IgnoreTargetAbility",
15:                                 "CategoryDependsOnHigherDamageIgnoreTargetAbility"].include?(function_code)
16:   end

19:

21:   def name;                          return @move.name;                    end
22:   def physicalMove?(thisType = nil); return @move.physicalMove?(thisType); end

29:

33:     return @move.pbCalcType(@ai.user.battler) if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
34:     return @move.type

39:   def pbTarget(user)
40:     return @move.pbTarget((user.is_a?(Battle::AI::AIBattler)) ? user.battler : user)
41:   end

43:   # Returns whether this move targets multiple battlers.
44:   def targets_multiple_battlers?
45:     user_battler = @ai.user.battler
46:     target_data = pbTarget(user_battler)
47:     return false if target_data.num_targets <= 1
48:     num_targets = 0
49:     case target_data.id
50:     when :AllAllies
51:       @ai.battle.allSameSideBattlers(user_battler).each { |b| num_targets += 1 if b.index != user_battler.index }
52:     when :UserAndAllies
53:       @ai.battle.allSameSideBattlers(user_battler).each { |_b| num_targets += 1 }
54:     when :AllNearFoes
55:       @ai.battle.allOtherSideBattlers(user_battler).each { |b| num_targets += 1 if b.near?(user_battler) }
56:     when :AllFoes
57:       @ai.battle.allOtherSideBattlers(user_battler).each { |_b| num_targets += 1 }
58:     when :AllNearOthers
59:       @ai.battle.allBattlers.each { |b| num_targets += 1 if b.near?(user_battler) }
60:     when :AllBattlers
61:       @ai.battle.allBattlers.each { |_b| num_targets += 1 }
62:     end
63:     return num_targets > 1
64:   end

67: 
68:   def rough_priority(user)
69:     ret = @move.pbPriority(user.battler)
70:     if user.ability_active?
71:       ret = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityChange(user.ability, user.battler, @move, ret)
72:       user.battler.effects[PBEffects::Prankster] = false   # Untrigger this
73:     end
74:     return ret
75:   end

77:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
78: 
79:   # Returns this move's base power, taking into account various effects that
80:   # modify it.
81:   def base_power
82:     ret = @move.power
83:     ret = 60 if ret == 1
84:     return ret if !@ai.trainer.medium_skill?
85:     return Battle::AI::Handlers.get_base_power(function_code,
86:        ret, self, @ai.user, @ai.target, @ai, @ai.battle)
87:   end
88: 
89:   # Full damage calculation.
90:   def rough_damage
91:     base_dmg = base_power
92:     return base_dmg if @move.is_a?(Battle::Move::FixedDamageMove)
93:     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
94:     stage_mul = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
95:     stage_div = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_DIVISORS
96:     # Get the user and target of this move
97:     user = @ai.user
98:     user_battler = user.battler
99:     target = @ai.target
100:     target_battler = target.battler
101:     # Get the move's type
102:     calc_type = rough_type
103:     # Decide whether the move has 50% chance of higher of being a critical hit
104:     crit_stage = rough_critical_hit_stage
105:     is_critical = crit_stage >= Battle::Move::CRITICAL_HIT_RATIOS.length ||
106:                   Battle::Move::CRITICAL_HIT_RATIOS[crit_stage] <= 2
107:     ##### Calculate user's attack stat #####
108:     if ["CategoryDependsOnHigherDamagePoisonTarget",
109:         "CategoryDependsOnHigherDamageIgnoreTargetAbility"].include?(function_code)
110:       @move.pbOnStartUse(user.battler, [target.battler])   # Calculate category
111:     end
112:     atk, atk_stage = @move.pbGetAttackStats(user.battler, target.battler)
113:     if !target.has_active_ability?(:UNAWARE) || @ai.battle.moldBreaker
114:       atk_stage = max_stage if is_critical && atk_stage < max_stage
115:       atk = (atk.to_f * stage_mul[atk_stage] / stage_div[atk_stage]).floor
116:     end
117:     ##### Calculate target's defense stat #####
118:     defense, def_stage = @move.pbGetDefenseStats(user.battler, target.battler)
119:     if !user.has_active_ability?(:UNAWARE) || @ai.battle.moldBreaker
120:       def_stage = max_stage if is_critical && def_stage > max_stage
121:       defense = (defense.to_f * stage_mul[def_stage] / stage_div[def_stage]).floor
122:     end
123:     ##### Calculate all multiplier effects #####
124:     multipliers = {
125:       :power_multiplier        => 1.0,
126:       :attack_multiplier       => 1.0,
127:       :defense_multiplier      => 1.0,
128:       :final_damage_multiplier => 1.0
129:     }
130:     # Global abilities
131:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill? &&
132:        ((@ai.battle.pbCheckGlobalAbility(:DARKAURA) && calc_type == :DARK) ||

289:       when :Sun, :HarshSun

291:         when :FIRE

293:         when :WATER

295:         end
296:       when :Rain, :HeavyRain

312:       if Settings::NEW_CRITICAL_HIT_RATE_MECHANICS

314:       else
315:         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2

317:     end
318:     # Random variance - n/a

321:       if user.has_active_ability?(:ADAPTABILITY)
322:         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2

324:         multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 1.5

328:     typemod = target.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(calc_type, user, @move)

332:        @move.damageReducedByBurn? && !user.has_active_ability?(:GUTS)
333:       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2

337:        !user.has_active_ability?(:INFILTRATOR)
338:       if target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::AuroraVeil] > 0
339:         if @ai.battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target_battler) > 1
340:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
341:         else
342:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
343:         end
344:       elsif target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Reflect] > 0 && physicalMove?(calc_type)
345:         if @ai.battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target_battler) > 1
346:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
347:         else
348:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
349:         end
350:       elsif target.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::LightScreen] > 0 && specialMove?(calc_type)
351:         if @ai.battle.pbSideBattlerCount(target_battler) > 1
352:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2 / 3.0
353:         else
354:           multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] /= 2
355:         end
356:       end
357:     end
358:     # Minimize
359:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill? && target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && @move.tramplesMinimize?
360:       multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier] *= 2
361:     end
362:     # NOTE: No need to check pbBaseDamageMultiplier, as it's already accounted
363:     #       for in an AI's MoveBasePower handler or can't be checked now anyway.
364:     # NOTE: No need to check pbModifyDamage, as it's already accounted for in an
365:     #       AI's MoveBasePower handler.
366:     ##### Main damage calculation #####
367:     base_dmg = [(base_dmg * multipliers[:power_multiplier]).round, 1].max
368:     atk      = [(atk      * multipliers[:attack_multiplier]).round, 1].max
369:     defense  = [(defense  * multipliers[:defense_multiplier]).round, 1].max
370:     damage   = ((((2.0 * user.level / 5) + 2).floor * base_dmg * atk / defense).floor / 50).floor + 2
371:     damage   = [(damage * multipliers[:final_damage_multiplier]).round, 1].max
372:     ret = damage.floor
373:     ret = target.hp - 1 if @move.nonLethal?(user_battler, target_battler) && ret >= target.hp
374:     return ret

378: 
379:   def accuracy
380:     return @move.pbBaseAccuracy(@ai.user.battler, @ai.target.battler) if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
381:     return @move.accuracy
382:   end
383: 
384:   # Full accuracy calculation.
385:   def rough_accuracy
386:     # Determine user and target
387:     user = @ai.user
388:     user_battler = user.battler
389:     target = @ai.target
390:     target_battler = target.battler
391:     # OHKO move accuracy
392:     if @move.is_a?(Battle::Move::OHKO)
393:       ret = self.accuracy + user.level - target.level
394:       ret -= 10 if function_code == "OHKOIce" && !user.has_type?(:ICE)
395:       return [ret, 0].max
396:     end
397:     # "Always hit" effects and "always hit" accuracy
398:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
399:       return 100 if target.effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] > 0
400:       return 100 if target.effects[PBEffects::Minimize] && @move.tramplesMinimize? &&

401:                     Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6
402:     end
403:     # Get base accuracy
404:     baseAcc = self.accuracy
405:     return 100 if baseAcc == 0
406:     # Get the move's type
407:     type = rough_type
408:     # Calculate all modifier effects
409:     modifiers = {}
410:     modifiers[:base_accuracy]  = baseAcc
411:     modifiers[:accuracy_stage] = user.stages[:ACCURACY]
412:     modifiers[:evasion_stage]  = target.stages[:EVASION]
413:     modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] = 1.0
414:     modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]  = 1.0
415:     apply_rough_accuracy_modifiers(user, target, type, modifiers)
416:     # Check if move certainly misses/can't miss
417:     return 0 if modifiers[:base_accuracy] < 0
418:     return 100 if modifiers[:base_accuracy] == 0
419:     # Calculation
420:     max_stage = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
421:     accStage = [[modifiers[:accuracy_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
422:     evaStage = [[modifiers[:evasion_stage], -max_stage].max, max_stage].min + max_stage
423:     stageMul = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_MULTIPLIERS
424:     stageDiv = Battle::Battler::ACC_EVA_STAGE_DIVISORS
425:     accuracy = 100.0 * stageMul[accStage] / stageDiv[accStage]
426:     evasion  = 100.0 * stageMul[evaStage] / stageDiv[evaStage]
427:     accuracy = (accuracy * modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier]).round
428:     evasion  = (evasion  * modifiers[:evasion_multiplier]).round
429:     evasion = 1 if evasion < 1
430:     return modifiers[:base_accuracy] * accuracy / evasion
431:   end
432: 
433:   def apply_rough_accuracy_modifiers(user, target, calc_type, modifiers)
434:     user_battler = user.battler
435:     target_battler = target.battler
436:     # Ability effects that alter accuracy calculation
437:     if user.ability_active?
438:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromUser(
439:         user.ability, modifiers, user_battler, target_battler, @move, calc_type
440:       )
441:     end
442:     user_battler.allAllies.each do |b|
443:       next if !b.abilityActive?
444:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromAlly(
445:         b.ability, modifiers, user_battler, target_battler, @move, calc_type
446:       )
447:     end
448:     if !@ai.battle.moldBreaker && target.ability_active?
449:       Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromTarget(
450:         target.ability, modifiers, user_battler, target_battler, @move, calc_type
451:       )
452:     end
453:     # Item effects that alter accuracy calculation
454:     if user.item_active?
455:       if user.item == :ZOOMLENS
456:         if rough_priority(user) <= 0
457:           modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] *= 1.2 if target.faster_than?(user)
458:         end
459:       else
460:         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromUser(
461:           user.item, modifiers, user_battler, target_battler, @move, calc_type
462:         )
463:       end
464:     end
465:     if target.item_active?
466:       Battle::ItemEffects.triggerAccuracyCalcFromTarget(
467:         target.item, modifiers, user_battler, target_battler, @move, calc_type
468:       )
469:     end
470:     # Other effects, inc. ones that set accuracy_multiplier or evasion_stage to specific values
471:     if @ai.battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0
472:       modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] *= 5 / 3.0
473:     end
474:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
475:       if user.effects[PBEffects::MicleBerry]
476:         modifiers[:accuracy_multiplier] *= 1.2
477:       end
478:       modifiers[:evasion_stage] = 0 if target.effects[PBEffects::Foresight] && modifiers[:evasion_stage] > 0
479:       modifiers[:evasion_stage] = 0 if target.effects[PBEffects::MiracleEye] && modifiers[:evasion_stage] > 0
480:     end
481:     # "AI-specific calculations below"
482:     modifiers[:evasion_stage] = 0 if function_code == "IgnoreTargetDefSpDefEvaStatStages"   # Chip Away
483:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
484:       modifiers[:base_accuracy] = 0 if user.effects[PBEffects::LockOn] > 0 &&
485:                                        user.effects[PBEffects::LockOnPos] == target.index
486:     end
487:     if @ai.trainer.medium_skill?
488:       case function_code
489:       when "BadPoisonTarget"
490:         modifiers[:base_accuracy] = 0 if Settings::MORE_TYPE_EFFECTS &&
491:                                          @move.statusMove? && user.has_type?(:POISON)
492:       end
493:     end
494:   end

496:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
497: 
498:   # Full critical hit chance calculation (returns the determined critical hit
499:   # stage).
500:   def rough_critical_hit_stage
501:     user = @ai.user
502:     user_battler = user.battler
503:     target = @ai.target
504:     target_battler = target.battler
505:     return -1 if target_battler.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::LuckyChant] > 0
506:     crit_stage = 0
507:     # Ability effects that alter critical hit rate
508:     if user.ability_active?
509:       crit_stage = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromUser(user_battler.ability,
510:          user_battler, target_battler, crit_stage)
511:       return -1 if crit_stage < 0
512:     end
513:     if !@ai.battle.moldBreaker && target.ability_active?
514:       crit_stage = Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromTarget(target_battler.ability,
515:          user_battler, target_battler, crit_stage)
516:       return -1 if crit_stage < 0
517:     end
518:     # Item effects that alter critical hit rate
519:     if user.item_active?
520:       crit_stage = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromUser(user_battler.item,
521:          user_battler, target_battler, crit_stage)
522:       return -1 if crit_stage < 0
523:     end
524:     if target.item_active?
525:       crit_stage = Battle::ItemEffects.triggerCriticalCalcFromTarget(user_battler.item,
526:          user_battler, target_battler, crit_stage)
527:       return -1 if crit_stage < 0
528:     end
529:     # Other effects
530:     case @move.pbCritialOverride(user_battler, target_battler)
531:     when 1  then return 99
532:     when -1 then return -1
533:     end
534:     return 99 if crit_stage > 50   # Merciless
535:     return 99 if user_battler.effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus] > 0
536:     crit_stage += 1 if @move.highCriticalRate?
537:     crit_stage += user_battler.effects[PBEffects::FocusEnergy]
538:     crit_stage += 1 if user_battler.inHyperMode? && @move.type == :SHADOW
539:     crit_stage = [crit_stage, Battle::Move::CRITICAL_HIT_RATIOS.length - 1].min
540:     return crit_stage
541:   end

543:   #-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
544: 
545:   # Return values:
546:   #   0: Regular additional effect chance or isn't an additional effect
547:   #   -999: Additional effect will be negated
548:   #   Other: Amount to add to a move's score
549:   def get_score_change_for_additional_effect(user, target = nil)
550:     # Doesn't have an additional effect
551:     return 0 if @move.addlEffect == 0
552:     # Additional effect will be negated
553:     return -999 if user.has_active_ability?(:SHEERFORCE)
554:     return -999 if target && user.index != target.index &&
555:                    target.has_active_ability?(:SHIELDDUST) && !@ai.battle.moldBreaker
556:     # Prefer if the additional effect will have an increased chance of working
557:     return 5 if @move.addlEffect < 100 &&
558:                 (Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 || function_code != "EffectDependsOnEnvironment") &&
559:                 (user.has_active_ability?(:SERENEGRACE) || user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Rainbow] > 0)
560:     # No change to score
561:     return 0
562:   end
563: end

1: # AI 通用数值、状态与阶级评估行为规格（净化正文；批次 12）
2: 
3: 分类：combat-requirements ＋ pokemon-rules（F12-08 部分）；性质：实现独立行为合同。
4: 
5: 本规格为净化正文：按统一交接将批准输入 WP52-A《AI 通用数值、状态与阶级评估》转写为独立行为文字，不含源文件路径、类名、行号与证据 URL（参考与已读集中登记于 `../../audit/source-traceability.md` 批次 12 条目）。文中保留的效果/能力/物品身份名、字段名与配置键均为数据标识，不构成未来实现的数据结构或接口模板。全部内容为静态证据；**无运行确认**（见 `../scope-statement.md`）。
6: 
7: ---
8: 
9: ## 1. 目的、概念、输入输出与责任（A）
10: 
11: 本规格描述 AI 为候选招式增加/减少偏好、预测不生效和取得近似数值的合同。分数不是伤害、概率或最优行动证明；真实执行与 WP40/43/44/48 不同的地方保留为具名 AI 差异，不反向改写真规则。WP51 负责候选合法性、技能来源、决策顺序、权重抽取和登记，本规格只给其评分输入。
12: 
13: U 为当前使用者，T 为当前评估目标，H 为相应总 HP，h 为当前 HP，d 为近似伤害。基础分 100、预计整招失败 20、无用 60；逐目标负分排除。中等技能 ≥ 32，高 ≥ 48；ScoreMoves、PredictMoveFailure、HPAware、PreferMultiTargetMoves 分别按 WP51 标记判断，不能由「高技能」统括替代。下文未写技能门的分支在该处理器被调到时就会考虑。
14:

114: ### 4.1 共同资格、值得改变与增量
115: 
116: 普通效果读取真实招式明确的升/降请求项目与数量，完整参数按 WP44 附表同名行及 K 合同，另在本包附表给身份连接。普通自身升、目标单降的变化招预测拒相应中央资格全不通过；伤害招不因附效不能施加而整招失败。多项任一中央资格可就不全败；它不等同真实多项招式镜甲预检，该预检及模式破坏例外仍 WP44。自身降作为伤害代价评分，whole_effect 假。
117: 
118: whole_effect 表示阶级是否整招收益，伤害招强制假；无收益时整招给 60，否则保留输入。固定变化用于直接交换/重设，绕中央资格、反向及单纯调整，但仍做「值得改变」、上下限、残余及天然等判断。升的方向系数：对侧 T 或能打敌方且 T 非 U 时 −1，其余 +1；降正好反过来。非固定、非模式破坏、有效唱反调时，原方向有利且整招则 60；否则按相反方向 helper 重新评估。
119: 
120: 附效 −999 保持；T 预计回合末损失 ≥ h 时无收益。升时若 T 没有辅助力量类而所有对手有效天然，无收益；降也做所有对手天然门但没有辅助力量例外。回合末近似完整分项在 WP51 §3.3，各项先取整和最低量再合成，不当实际终局预测。H11、HP2、可治可间伤、有效雨期限2、RAINDISH+Curse、无其它残余，d=1，因此此处 d≥h 的局部门为假；增/降阶仍继续其它资格与收益检查，不能推成整招固定分或最终选择。先排不值得项目，再单纯 ×2（无模式破坏、非固定），夹到剩余 ±6 空间，只保留正请求量；全空无收益。
121: 
122: 值得改变：攻击要有可用物理招且排以防代攻/借目标攻；特攻要有可用特殊招；防御要求某对手有物理或以物防代特防招，特防要求某对手特殊且非该替代；升速需某敌速度严格在己速与 2.5 己速间，或己有电球/辅助力量；降速需己速严格在某敌速与 2.5 敌速间，或同两招；升命中若最小原命中 ≥ 90 且己命中阶非负，需至少敌有正闪避，最小原命中枚举全部槽、排必中/OHKO 但不按 PP 过滤；降命中只需有原命中 > 0 非 OHKO。闪避无额外有用门。升的接力棒/辅助力量提前视有用，不直接套给降。
123: 
124: ### 4.2 数值与局部差异
125: 
126: 实际正请求量总和 n。U 在场轮 < 2 且变化招加 5n × 方向；HPAware 以各人的整数 HP 百分比减 50，乘 n × 方向后整除 8：T 贡献总有，T 非 U 时另加 U 贡献。负整数除法向下取整，不同于最终分向 0 截断。降对侧 T 且其能力身份有 OnStatLoss 登记再 −10，此处不先查能力有效性。
127: 
128: 单项相对量 r =「升后/升前倍率 − 1」乘方向；下降用「降前/降后倍率 − 1」乘方向。普通阶级二分基数，命中闪避三分基数。攻/特攻一般加 8r（同时有另一攻击类别）或 12r（没有）；防/特防 10r。原升已 ≥ +2 且只升 1、或原降 ≤ −2 且只降 1 时，改为减 10 × 符号；符号在 T 对侧时 1，否则为方向。

143: #===============================================================================
144: # A stripped-down version of class HandlerHash which only deals with IDs that
145: # are symbols. Also contains an add_ifs hash for code that applies to multiple
146: # IDs (determined by its condition proc).
147: #===============================================================================
148: class HandlerHashSymbol
149:   def initialize
150:     @hash    = {}
151:     @add_ifs = {}
152:   end
153: 
154:   def [](sym)
155:     sym = sym.id if !sym.is_a?(Symbol) && sym.respond_to?("id")
156:     return @hash[sym] if sym && @hash[sym]
157:     @add_ifs.each_value do |add_if|
158:       return add_if[1] if add_if[0].call(sym)
159:     end
160:     return nil
161:   end
162: 
163:   def add(sym, handler = nil, &handlerBlock)
164:     if ![Proc, Hash].include?(handler.class) && !block_given?
165:       raise ArgumentError, "#{self.class.name} for #{sym.inspect} has no valid handler (#{handler.inspect} was given)"
166:     end
167:     @hash[sym] = handler || handlerBlock if sym
168:   end
169: 
170:   def addIf(sym, conditionProc, handler = nil, &handlerBlock)
171:     if ![Proc, Hash].include?(handler.class) && !block_given?
172:       raise ArgumentError, "addIf call for #{sym} in #{self.class.name} has no valid handler (#{handler.inspect} was given)"
173:     end
174:     @add_ifs[sym] = [conditionProc, handler || handlerBlock]
175:   end
176: 
177:   def copy(src, *dests)
178:     handler = self[src]
179:     return if !handler
180:     dests.each { |dest| add(dest, handler) }
181:   end
182: 
183:   def remove(key)
184:     @hash.delete(key)
185:   end
186: 
187:   def clear
188:     @hash.clear
189:     @add_ifs.clear
190:   end
191: 
192:   def trigger(sym, *args)
193:     sym = sym.id if !sym.is_a?(Symbol) && sym.respond_to?("id")
194:     handler = self[sym]
195:     return handler&.call(sym, *args)
196:   end
197: end

120:       when 4   # Poké Balls
121:         next false if idxPkmn < 0
122:         battler = @battlers[idxPkmn]
123:         pkmn    = battler.pokemon if battler
124:       when 5   # No target (Poké Doll, Guard Spec., Launcher items)
125:         battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
126:         pkmn    = battler.pokemon if battler
127:       else
128:         next false
129:       end
130:       next false if !pkmn
131:       next false if !ItemHandlers.triggerCanUseInBattle(item, pkmn, battler, idxMove,
132:                                                         firstAction, self, itemScene)
133:       next false if !pbRegisterItem(idxBattler, item, idxPkmn, idxMove)
134:       ret = true
135:       next true
136:     end
137:     return ret
138:   end
139: 
140:   def pbPartyMenu(idxBattler)
141:     ret = -1
142:     if @debug
143:       ret = @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseNewEnemy(idxBattler)
144:     else
145:       ret = pbPartyScreen(idxBattler, false, true, true)
146:     end
147:     return ret >= 0
148:   end
149: 
150:   def pbRunMenu(idxBattler)
151:     # Regardless of succeeding or failing to run, stop choosing actions
152:     return pbRun(idxBattler) != 0
153:   end
154: 
155:   def pbCallMenu(idxBattler)
156:     return pbRegisterCall(idxBattler)
157:   end
158: 
159:   def pbDebugMenu
160:     pbBattleDebug(self)
161:     @scene.pbRefreshEverything
162:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange }
163:     pbEndPrimordialWeather
164:     allBattlers.each { |b| b.pbAbilityOnTerrainChange }
165:     allBattlers.each do |b|
166:       b.pbCheckFormOnMovesetChange
167:       b.pbCheckFormOnStatusChange
168:     end
169:   end
170: 
171:   #=============================================================================
172:   # Command phase
173:   #=============================================================================
174:   def pbCommandPhase
175:     @command_phase = true
176:     @scene.pbBeginCommandPhase
177:     # Reset choices if commands can be shown
178:     @battlers.each_with_index do |b, i|
179:       next if !b
180:       pbClearChoice(i) if pbCanShowCommands?(i)
181:     end
182:     # Reset choices to perform Mega Evolution if it wasn't done somehow
183:     2.times do |side|
184:       @megaEvolution[side].each_with_index do |megaEvo, i|
185:         @megaEvolution[side][i] = -1 if megaEvo >= 0
186:       end
187:     end
188:     # Choose actions for the round (player first, then AI)
189:     pbCommandPhaseLoop(true)    # Player chooses their actions
190:     if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions
191:       @command_phase = false
192:       return
193:     end
194:     pbCommandPhaseLoop(false)   # AI chooses their actions
195:     @command_phase = false
196:   end
197: 
198:   def pbCommandPhaseLoop(isPlayer)
199:     # NOTE: Doing some things (e.g. running, throwing a Poké Ball) takes up all
200:     #       your actions in a round.
201:     actioned = []
202:     idxBattler = -1
203:     loop do
204:       break if @decision != 0   # Battle ended, stop choosing actions
205:       idxBattler += 1
206:       break if idxBattler >= @battlers.length
207:       next if !@battlers[idxBattler] || pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler) != isPlayer
208:       if @choices[idxBattler][0] != :None || !pbCanShowCommands?(idxBattler)
209:         # Action is forced, can't choose one
210:         PBDebug.log_ai("#{@battlers[idxBattler].pbThis} (#{idxBattler}) is forced to use a multi-turn move")
211:         next
212:       end
213:       # AI controls this battler
214:       if @controlPlayer || !pbOwnedByPlayer?(idxBattler)
215:         @battleAI.pbDefaultChooseEnemyCommand(idxBattler)
216:         next
217:       end
218:       # Player chooses an action
219:       actioned.push(idxBattler)
220:       commandsEnd = false   # Whether to cancel choosing all other actions this round
221:       loop do
222:         cmd = pbCommandMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
223:         # If being Sky Dropped, can't do anything except use a move
224:         if cmd > 0 && @battlers[idxBattler].effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
225:           pbDisplay(_INTL("Sky Drop won't let {1} go!", @battlers[idxBattler].pbThis(true)))
226:           next
227:         end
228:         case cmd
229:         when 0    # Fight
230:           break if pbFightMenu(idxBattler)
231:         when 1    # Bag
232:           if pbItemMenu(idxBattler, actioned.length == 1)
233:             commandsEnd = true if pbItemUsesAllActions?(@choices[idxBattler][1])
234:             break
235:           end
236:         when 2    # Pokémon
237:           break if pbPartyMenu(idxBattler)
238:         when 3    # Run
239:           # NOTE: "Run" is only an available option for the first battler the
240:           #       player chooses an action for in a round. Attempting to run
241:           #       from battle prevents you from choosing any other actions in
242:           #       that round.
243:           if pbRunMenu(idxBattler)
244:             commandsEnd = true
245:             break
246:           end
247:         when 4    # Call
248:           break if pbCallMenu(idxBattler)
249:         when -2   # Debug
250:           pbDebugMenu
251:           next
252:         when -1   # Go back to previous battler's action choice
253:           next if actioned.length <= 1
254:           actioned.pop   # Forget this battler was done
255:           idxBattler = actioned.last - 1
256:           pbCancelChoice(idxBattler + 1)   # Clear the previous battler's choice
257:           actioned.pop   # Forget the previous battler was done
258:           break
259:         end
260:         pbCancelChoice(idxBattler)
261:       end
262:       break if commandsEnd
263:     end
264:   end
265: end

      if optional_suffix && !optional_suffix.empty?
        ret = path + tr_type_data.id.to_s + optional_suffix + suffix
        return ret if pbResolveBitmap(ret)
      end
      ret = path + tr_type_data.id.to_s + suffix
      return (pbResolveBitmap(ret)) ? ret : nil
    end

      ret&.slice!("Graphics/Characters/")
      return ret
    end

    def self.front_sprite_filename(tr_type)
      return self.check_file(tr_type, "Graphics/Trainers/")

    end

    def initialize(hash)
      @id              = hash[:id]
      @real_name       = hash[:real_name]       || "Unnamed"
      @gender          = hash[:gender]          || 2
      @base_money      = hash[:base_money]      || 30
      @skill_level     = hash[:skill_level]     || @base_money
      @flags           = hash[:flags]           || []
      @intro_BGM       = hash[:intro_BGM]
      @battle_BGM      = hash[:battle_BGM]
      @victory_BGM     = hash[:victory_BGM]
      @pbs_file_suffix = hash[:pbs_file_suffix] || ""
    end

    # @return [String] the translated name of this trainer type
    def name
      return pbGetMessageFromHash(MessageTypes::TRAINER_TYPE_NAMES, @real_name)
    end

    def male?;   return @gender == 0; end
    def female?; return @gender == 1; end

    def has_flag?(flag)
      return @flags.any? { |f| f.downcase == flag.downcase }
    end

    alias __orig__get_property_for_PBS get_property_for_PBS unless method_defined?(:__orig__get_property_for_PBS)
    def get_property_for_PBS(key)
      key = "SectionName" if key == "ID"
      ret = __orig__get_property_for_PBS(key)
      ret = nil if key == "SkillLevel" && ret == @base_money
      return ret
    end
  end
end
