# Basic trainer class (use a child class rather than this one)

class Trainer
  attr_accessor :trainer_type
  attr_accessor :name
  attr_accessor :id
  attr_accessor :language
  attr_accessor :party

  def inspect
    str = super.chop
    party_str = @party.map { |p| p.species_data.species }.inspect
    str << sprintf(" %s @party=%s>", self.full_name, party_str)
    return str
  end

  def full_name
    return @name if has_flag?("NoName")
    return "#{trainer_type_name} #{@name}"
  end

  #=============================================================================

  # Portion of the ID which is visible on the Trainer Card
  def public_ID(id = nil)
    return id ? id & 0xFFFF : @id & 0xFFFF
  end

  # Other portion of the ID
  def secret_ID(id = nil)
    return id ? id >> 16 : @id >> 16
  end

  # Random ID other than this Trainer's ID
  def make_foreign_ID
    loop do
      ret = rand(2**16) | (rand(2**16) << 16)
      return ret if ret != @id
    end
    return 0
  end

  #=============================================================================

  def trainer_type_name; return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).name;            end
  def base_money;        return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).base_money;      end
  def gender;            return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).gender;          end
  def male?;             return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).male?;           end
  def female?;           return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).female?;         end
  def skill_level;       return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).skill_level;     end
  def flags;             return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).flags;           end
  def has_flag?(flag);   return GameData::TrainerType.get(self.trainer_type).has_flag?(flag); end

  #=============================================================================

  def pokemon_party
    return @party.find_all { |p| p && !p.egg? }
  end

  def able_party
    return @party.find_all { |p| p && !p.egg? && !p.fainted? }
  end

  def party_count
    return @party.length
  end

  def pokemon_count
    ret = 0
    @party.each { |p| ret += 1 if p && !p.egg? }
    return ret
  end

  def able_pokemon_count
    ret = 0
    @party.each { |p| ret += 1 if p && !p.egg? && !p.fainted? }
    return ret
  end

  def party_full?
    return party_count >= Settings::MAX_PARTY_SIZE
  end

module PBDebug
  @@log = []

  def self.logonerr
    begin
      yield
    rescue
      PBDebug.log("")
      PBDebug.log("**Exception: #{$!.message}")
      backtrace = ""
      $!.backtrace.each { |line| backtrace += line + "\r\n" }
      PBDebug.log(backtrace)
      PBDebug.log("")
      pbPrintException($!)   # if $INTERNAL
      PBDebug.flush
    end
  end

  def self.flush
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL && @@log.length > 0
      File.open("Data/debuglog.txt", "a+b") { |f| f.write(@@log.join) }
    end
    @@log.clear
  end

  def self.log(msg)
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      echoln msg.gsub("%", "%%")
      @@log.push(msg + "\r\n")
      PBDebug.flush   # if @@log.length > 1024
    end
  end

  def self.log_header(msg)
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      echoln Console.markup_style(msg.gsub("%", "%%"), text: :light_purple)
      @@log.push(msg + "\r\n")
      PBDebug.flush   # if @@log.length > 1024
    end
  end

  def self.log_message(msg)
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      msg = "\"" + msg + "\""
      echoln Console.markup_style(msg.gsub("%", "%%"), text: :dark_gray)
      @@log.push(msg + "\r\n")
      PBDebug.flush   # if @@log.length > 1024
    end
  end

  def self.log_ai(msg)
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      msg = "[AI] " + msg
      echoln msg.gsub("%", "%%")
      @@log.push(msg + "\r\n")
      PBDebug.flush   # if @@log.length > 1024
    end
  end

  def self.log_score_change(amt, msg)
    return if amt == 0
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      sign = (amt > 0) ? "+" : "-"
      amt_text = sprintf("%3d", amt.abs)
      msg = "     #{sign}#{amt_text}: #{msg}"
      echoln msg.gsub("%", "%%")
      @@log.push(msg + "\r\n")
      PBDebug.flush   # if @@log.length > 1024
    end
  end

  def self.dump(msg)
    if $DEBUG && $INTERNAL
      File.open("Data/dumplog.txt", "a+b") { |f| f.write("#{msg}\r\n") }
    end
  end
end

67:   def pbMoveCategory(move)
68:     if move.target == :User || move.function_code == "MultiTurnAttackBideThenReturnDoubleDamage"

79:   def pbCanChooseMovePartial?(idxPokemon, idxMove)

81:     thismove = thispkmn.moves[idxMove]
82:     return false if !thismove
83:     return false if thismove.pp <= 0
84:     if thispkmn.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] &&

86:        thispkmn.hasActiveItem?(:CHOICEBAND)

1: class Battle::Battler
2:   #=============================================================================
3:   # Decide whether the trainer is allowed to tell the Pokémon to use the given
4:   # move. Called when choosing a command for the round.
5:   # Also called when processing the Pokémon's action, because these effects also
6:   # prevent Pokémon action. Relevant because these effects can become active
7:   # earlier in the same round (after choosing the command but before using the
8:   # move) or an unusable move may be called by another move such as Metronome.
9:   #=============================================================================
10:   def pbCanChooseMove?(move, commandPhase, showMessages = true, specialUsage = false)
11:     # Disable
12:     if @effects[PBEffects::DisableMove] == move.id && !specialUsage
13:       if showMessages
14:         msg = _INTL("{1}'s {2} is disabled!", pbThis, move.name)
15:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
16:       end
17:       return false
18:     end
19:     # Heal Block
20:     if @effects[PBEffects::HealBlock] > 0 && move.healingMove?
21:       if showMessages
22:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Heal Block!", pbThis, move.name)
23:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
24:       end
25:       return false
26:     end
27:     # Gravity
28:     if @battle.field.effects[PBEffects::Gravity] > 0 && move.unusableInGravity?
29:       if showMessages
30:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of gravity!", pbThis, move.name)
31:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
32:       end
33:       return false
34:     end
35:     # Throat Chop
36:     if @effects[PBEffects::ThroatChop] > 0 && move.soundMove?
37:       if showMessages
38:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} because of Throat Chop!", pbThis, move.name)
39:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
40:       end
41:       return false
42:     end
43:     # Choice Band/Gorilla Tactics
44:     @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] = nil if !pbHasMove?(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
45:     if @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] && move.id != @effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand]
46:       choiced_move = GameData::Move.try_get(@effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand])
47:       if choiced_move
48:         if hasActiveItem?([:CHOICEBAND, :CHOICESPECS, :CHOICESCARF])
49:           if showMessages
50:             msg = _INTL("The {1} only allows the use of {2}!", itemName, choiced_move.name)
51:             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
52:           end
53:           return false
54:         elsif hasActiveAbility?(:GORILLATACTICS)
55:           if showMessages
56:             msg = _INTL("{1} can only use {2}!", pbThis, choiced_move.name)
57:             (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
58:           end
59:           return false
60:         end
61:       end
62:     end
63:     # Taunt
64:     if @effects[PBEffects::Taunt] > 0 && move.statusMove? && !specialUsage
65:       if showMessages
66:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use {2} after the taunt!", pbThis, move.name)
67:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
68:       end
69:       return false
70:     end
71:     # Torment
72:     if @effects[PBEffects::Torment] && !@effects[PBEffects::Instructed] && !specialUsage &&
73:        @lastMoveUsed && move.id == @lastMoveUsed && move.id != @battle.struggle.id
74:       if showMessages
75:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use the same move twice in a row due to the torment!", pbThis)
76:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
77:       end
78:       return false
79:     end
80:     # Imprison
81:     if @battle.allOtherSideBattlers(@index).any? { |b| b.effects[PBEffects::Imprison] && b.pbHasMove?(move.id) }
82:       if showMessages
83:         msg = _INTL("{1} can't use its sealed {2}!", pbThis, move.name)
84:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
85:       end
86:       return false
87:     end
88:     # Assault Vest (prevents choosing status moves but doesn't prevent
89:     # executing them)
90:     if hasActiveItem?(:ASSAULTVEST) && move.statusMove? && move.function_code != "UseMoveTargetIsAboutToUse" && commandPhase
91:       if showMessages
92:         msg = _INTL("The effects of the {1} prevent status moves from being used!", itemName)
93:         (commandPhase) ? @battle.pbDisplayPaused(msg) : @battle.pbDisplay(msg)
94:       end
95:       return false
96:     end
97:     # Belch
98:     return false if !move.pbCanChooseMove?(self, commandPhase, showMessages)
99:     return true
100:   end

#===============================================================================
# This script modifies the battle system to implement battle rules
#===============================================================================
class Battle
  unless @__clauses__aliased
    alias __clauses__pbDecisionOnDraw pbDecisionOnDraw
    alias __clauses__pbEndOfRoundPhase pbEndOfRoundPhase
    @__clauses__aliased = true
  end

  def pbDecisionOnDraw
    if @rules["selfkoclause"]
      if self.lastMoveUser < 0
        # in extreme cases there may be no last move user
        return 5   # game is a draw
      elsif opposes?(self.lastMoveUser)
        return 2   # loss
      else
        return 1   # win
      end
    end
    return __clauses__pbDecisionOnDraw
  end

  def pbJudgeCheckpoint(user, move = nil)
    if pbAllFainted?(0) && pbAllFainted?(1)
      if @rules["drawclause"]   # NOTE: Also includes Life Orb (not implemented)
        if !(move && move.function_code == "HealUserByHalfOfDamageDone")
          # Not a draw if fainting occurred due to Liquid Ooze
          @decision = (user.opposes?) ? 1 : 2   # win / loss
        end
      elsif @rules["modifiedselfdestructclause"]
        if move && move.function_code == "UserFaintsExplosive"   # Self-Destruct
          @decision = (user.opposes?) ? 1 : 2   # win / loss
        end
      end
    end
  end

  def pbEndOfRoundPhase
    __clauses__pbEndOfRoundPhase
    if @rules["suddendeath"] && @decision == 0
      p1able = pbAbleCount(0)
      p2able = pbAbleCount(1)
      if p1able > p2able
        @decision = 1   # loss
      elsif p1able < p2able
        @decision = 2   # win
      end
    end
  end
end

class Battle::Battler
  unless @__clauses__aliased
    alias __clauses__pbCanSleep? pbCanSleep?
    alias __clauses__pbCanSleepYawn? pbCanSleepYawn?
    alias __clauses__pbCanFreeze? pbCanFreeze?
    alias __clauses__pbUseMove pbUseMove
    @__clauses__aliased = true
  end

  def pbCanSleep?(user, showMessages, move = nil, ignoreStatus = false)
    selfsleep = (user && user.index == @index)
    if ((@battle.rules["modifiedsleepclause"]) || (!selfsleep && @battle.rules["sleepclause"])) &&
       pbHasStatusPokemon?(:SLEEP)
      if showMessages
        @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But {1} couldn't sleep!", pbThis(true)))
      end
      return false
    end
    return __clauses__pbCanSleep?(user, showMessages, move, ignoreStatus)
  end

  def pbCanSleepYawn?
    if (@battle.rules["sleepclause"] || @battle.rules["modifiedsleepclause"]) &&
       pbHasStatusPokemon?(:SLEEP)
      return false
    end
    return __clauses__pbCanSleepYawn?
  end

  def pbCanFreeze?(*arg)
    if @battle.rules["freezeclause"] && pbHasStatusPokemon?(:FROZEN)
      return false
    end
    return __clauses__pbCanFreeze?(*arg)
  end

  def pbHasStatusPokemon?(status)
    count = 0
    @battle.pbParty(@index).each do |pkmn|
      next if !pkmn || pkmn.egg?
      next if pkmn.status != status
      count += 1
    end
    return count > 0
  end
end

# R6-CA / effects-a 独立分审报告

完成分配的静态分域：006_AI MoveEffects/001–003 三文件3662行全文、逐登记/复制/消费者/技能门，以及 WP52-A 两整篇、B/C两正文及两附表整篇和对应测试目录整篇，共10个整篇输入5219行，可审未读0。无本分域运行验证。**不是整轮AI或全仓库已完成声明**；005_AI核心完整数值/选择链由父审独立负责，反向矩阵明确分开其语义责任，不能拿本报告覆盖父域。

有一项低影响定位提案 `R6-CA-EA-P001`（B覆盖表21将危害失败定位5.1，应5.2），行为正文未发现该项错误。待非提出者反证、root裁决。对 `GR6-C-001` 已写非提出者独立反证：未推翻内部空槽异常，补全九种初始布局与倒下/重设保留对象的区别、前门短路和异常屏蔽；最终分类仍由root。没有启动update，也没有更新正式文件。

## 输入和指令

AGENTS.md全文在首调用阅读，297行；未发现分配输入目录下其它适用AGENTS。只写本目录；与用户约束冲突的全局Feature Matrix修改改为本地双向矩阵交父整合。工具均为自己先写且全文理解的审计脚本，只读指定仓库文字、绑定独立输出；没有执行参考或旧脚本。

| 输入 | 独立核对值 |
| --- | --- |
| 主HEAD/tree | `8ea169fbd0f33f378b5d732fd6bea59e854e04a6` / `6ab3429170d2762607fbc2237014c3a160449fa1` |
| formal树 | `1046fbb657882e84b3dfc6d017943a9edf7782e5` |

| 实际逐输入内容 | `coverage-proof.json` 的10个Git blob全部与固定提交相符 |
| 请求执行档 | gpt-6.1-sol / ultra / default普速，禁Fast |

## 覆盖不是语义自动通过

`inventory-registrations.csv` 只做结构分母：001=55、002=206、003=88，共349个出现；另本轮全文读取能力评级登记25个入口，总374行、225个身份。`build_inventory.py` 不把读取或解析当语义通过。

`semantic-facts.json` 是实际读源后逐身份写的行为和边界说明；`forward-matrix.csv` 将374条逐族/身份登记分别连到事实、当前消费者、flag/skill门和正式正文精确行。普通多份复制分别保留实际请求参数，不冻结原始攻击参数；没有其它文件对本集合相同族/身份重新登记的搜索结果见 `static-checks.json`。同分、异常、缺消费者、copy默认不按一个PASS覆盖。

`reverse-matrix.csv` 对公共formal-block-denominator中相关7篇的1181个块定位，保留原clause ID和行。属于本分域的正文/数据行连接实际源事实；通用22修正/粗伤命中数值等父域条款标为READ_PARENT_SEMANTIC_OWNER，只有新全文阅读，未借本分审名义重算其完整语义。B/C外部效果、物品表/条件组/其它AB/AI测试同理。全文阅读与本地语义责任不混同；父审整合必须继续保留这些归属，不能把397个scope/other-owner块改写为本分审PASS。

`reading-ledger.jsonl` 和 `logs/*.<start>-<end>.txt` 持久连续区间。首个A整篇输出的122行显示缩略，已实读110–143补段。三个越界读取尝试被断言拒绝（009至145、011至564、Battler Initialize至331），随后分别按实际100/563/325尾行补读；失败本身不计阅读。最终覆盖证明的源与正式整篇均无缺段。辅助依赖按真实必要区间阅读，不能据此宣称那些辅助文件全文完成。

## 核对重点和结论

245: `UserTargetAverageHP` 是从阶级效果覆盖表移交的独立 HP 合同（默认 PAINSPLIT），不改变阶级。以下前提为双方存活，已通过行动、PP、目标范围、保护和替身等普通前门；默认数据为变化招、命中 0，可被保护且未设忽略替身。
246: 
247: 用进入本效果时两端当前 HP 一次求出 **m＝⌊(U.hp＋T.hp)/2⌋**。先处理使用者，再处理目标：当前 HP 高于 m 则减至 m，低于 m 则请求恢复到 m，等于 m 则不做这一端的 HP 增减；恢复各自受本端总 HP 上限限制。两端都用同一个 m，不在使用者提交后重算，不要求最终 HP 相等或合计守恒。恢复直接提交，不在此重查普通“可恢复”资格；本招本身没有治疗招标记，所以使用者只有正治疗封锁计数时仍可使用，不能据名称归入普通治疗门。目标未被绕过的替身或保护则在更早的目标检查阻止该效果，两种前提应分别做对照。
248: 
249: 本次减少 HP 不新增普通直接招式伤害记录及本轮受伤/跨半标记，既有记录不因此清空；恢复若达到半 HP 会按共享 HP 恢复规则清跨半标记。HP 写入沿战斗参与者与其关联持久个体的既有写回合同。双方 HP 处理完成后仍显示均分反馈，然后先检查使用者、再检查目标的 HP 恢复物品；即使两端 HP 原本等于 m，这两个检查也不会因未增减而略过。物品有效性、资格、消耗与可能的后续连锁沿持有物规格，不能把检查请求等同无条件恢复；其结果可能继续改变 HP 和持久持物。
250: 
251: 静态例：U 为 51/60、T 为 150/200，无影响本例的能力、物品或回调，m＝100，物品检查前及后都是 U60/T100，合计由 201 变 160。U1/T2、各总 HP100 得 m1，结果 1/1；两端各 50/100 且无有效物品时 HP 不变但仍有反馈和两端物品检查。完整正反例见 MH39–MH44；这不是已执行行为测试。
252: 
253: ## 7. 反伤、自损与同归
254: 
255: | 身份 | 何时/用何值/失败与守卫 |
256: | --- | --- |
257: | RecoilQuarterOfDamageDealt／RecoilThirdOfDamageDealt／RecoilHalfOfDamageDealt | 逐目标所有击后，T 未 unaffected、U 可受间伤且无有效 ROCKHEAD 才按该 T 的 totalHPLost 取 R(1/4／1/3／1/2)，最少 1，中央扣 HP 后检查恢复物品；不是每击单独向上补 1 |
258: | RecoilThirdOfDamageDealtParalyzeTarget／RecoilThirdOfDamageDealtBurnTarget | 同 1/3 反伤；另在每击数据附效机会下尝试麻痹/灼伤，替身挡附效。防反伤不自动禁止目标附效 |
259: | Struggle（特殊内建动作） | 无类型物理 P50、命中 0、PP−1、近随机对手、接触和可保护标记；所有击后 T 未 unaffected 就损 R(U.H/4)，不检查 MAGICGUARD/ROCKHEAD；恢复物品随后检查。使用入口仍按命令规格，不能统括免检查 |
260: | CrashDamageIfFailsUnusableInGravity | 被标为反伤、重力不可用；实际坠落在该击无任何目标成功且不准空目标时，U 可受间伤才损总 HP 整除 2 → 恢复物品 → 濒死。普通 ROCKHEAD 不能拦此路径；不能将更早整招前置失败一律加坠落 |
